title: Dell Pro Explained: Essential vs Pro vs Plus vs Premium | JLS Computers
text:
TL;DR: At CES in January 2025, Dell replaced its old business names. Latitude laptops and OptiPlex desktops became Dell Pro, and Precision workstations became Dell Pro Max.

Dell Pro laptops come in rising tiers: Essential (entry business, from about R15,000), Pro (the base model), Plus (lighter, better battery and screen) and Premium (thinnest, best build). For most small offices, a Pro 14 Essential or Pro 14 Plus with the SD25 dock is the right setup.

## What happened to Latitude, OptiPlex and Precision?

Dell simplified its PC names into three families, announced at CES 2025:

| New family | Who it’s for | Replaces |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Dell | Home, school and personal use | Inspiron and XPS |
| Dell Pro | Business laptops and desktops | Latitude (laptops) and OptiPlex (desktops) |
| Dell Pro Max | Engineers, designers, data and video professionals | Precision workstations |

Sources: RackSolutions, Pickr (CES 2025 coverage).

So if your company used to buy Latitude 5000-series laptops, the closest Dell Pro models are now the Pro and Pro Plus. The old OptiPlex Micro, Small Form Factor and Tower are now the Dell Pro Micro, Slim and Tower.

## Dell Pro Essential vs Pro vs Plus vs Premium

| Tier | Example model code | Who it’s for | From (JLS price) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pro Essential | PV14250, PV15250 | Entry business laptops for admin, sales and front-desk staff. Some ship with Windows 11 Home. | R14,965 |
| Pro (base) | PC14250, PC16250 | The everyday corporate laptop, the old Latitude 5000 role. Windows 11 Pro. | R33,741 |
| Pro Plus | PB13250, PB14250, PB16250 | Lighter, with longer battery life, better screens and options such as 5G and 2-in-1 | R33,498 |
| Pro Premium | PA13250, PA14250 | Executives and frequent travellers who want the thinnest, lightest and best-built model | R46,593 |

Prices on jlscomputers.co.za, 30 October 2026, for the lowest listed configuration in each tier.

### How to read a Dell Pro model code

Searching for a part number like PV14250? Read it in three parts:

- The letters give the tier: PV = Pro Essential, PC = Pro, PB = Pro Plus, PA = Pro Premium.
- The first two digits are the screen size: 13, 14, 15 or 16 inches.
- The last three digits mark the generation, for example 250 for the 2025 range.

So PV14250 is a Dell Pro 14 Essential, PB16250 is a Dell Pro 16 Plus and PA13250 is a Dell Pro 13 Premium. An AMD version usually ends in 5, as in the PV14255.

The entry business laptop: Dell Pro 14 Essential (PV14250), from R14,965

## Which Dell Pro laptop should I buy?

| Laptop | Specs | Best for | Price |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dell Pro 14 Essential PV14250 | Core 3 100U, 8 GB, 512 GB, Win 11 Home | Reception, admin, light use | R14,965 |
| Dell Pro 15 Essential PV15250 | Intel Core i5, 15.6″ | Office staff who want a bigger screen and number pad | R17,571 |
| Dell Pro 14 Essential PV14250 | Core 7 150U, 16 GB, 512 GB, Win 11 Home | Best-value Essential for heavier multitasking | R21,358 |
| Dell Pro 16 Plus PB16250 | Core Ultra 5 236V, 16 GB, 512 GB, Win 11 Pro | Finance and spreadsheet users on a 16″ screen | R33,498 |
| Dell Pro 14 PC14250 | Core Ultra 7 255U, 16 GB, 512 GB, Win 11 Pro | Standard corporate fleet laptop | R33,741 |
| Dell Pro 14 Plus PB14250 | Core Ultra 5 236V, 16 GB, 512 GB, Win 11 Pro | Managers and hybrid workers who travel | R35,354 |
| Dell Pro 14 Premium PA14250 | Core Ultra 7 266V, 16 GB, 512 GB, Win 11 Pro | Executives | R46,593 |

Prices on jlscomputers.co.za, 30 October 2026. Dell business stock is often built to order, so some listings show “confirm stock”. We’ll confirm availability and lead time before you pay.

Windows 11 Home or Pro? If your office uses a domain, Intune, BitLocker management or Remote Desktop into the laptop, you need Windows 11 Pro. Several Essential models ship with Home, and the upgrade to Pro costs extra. Ask us to quote the Pro version instead.

For managers and hybrid workers: Dell Pro 14 Plus (PB14250), R35,354

...

### Is Dell Pro the same as Latitude?

Dell Pro is the new name for Dell’s business laptops, replacing Latitude from 2025. The Pro and Pro Plus tiers fill the old Latitude 5000 and 7000 roles.

### What is the difference between Dell Pro 14 Essential and Dell Pro 14 Plus?

The Essential (PV14250) is the entry business model with mainstream Intel Core processors. The Plus (PB14250) uses newer Core Ultra processors, is lighter, has better battery life and offers more options. At JLS, the Plus costs roughly R14,000 more for a similar memory and storage spec.

title: Dell Technologies Launches Dell 14S Laptop at ₹79,990
text:
Dell Technologies Launches Dell 14S Laptop at ₹79,990

# Dell Technologies Launches Dell 14S Laptop at ₹79,990

 

person Business MInutes

November 11, 2026

Dell Technologies has launched the new Dell 14S laptop in India, targeting students and young professionals with a combination of stylish design, portability and long battery life. Featuring an aluminium chassis, the laptop is available in four colours – Linen, Dusty Rose, Washed Denim and Velvet Green. It is powered by the latest Intel Core 5 and Core 7 Series 3 processors with built-in AI capabilities, and offers up to 16GB memory and 1TB SSD storage.

The Dell 14S is just 13.5mm thin and weighs from 1.15kg, making it suitable for everyday use. It offers up to 21 hours of Netflix streaming on a single charge, along with a choice of 14-inch 2.8K 120Hz and 2K 60Hz display options. Other features include Dolby Atmos audio, a 1080p camera, Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.4 and multiple connectivity ports.

Raj Kumar Rishi, Vice President and General Manager, Consumer Business, Asia Pacific and Japan, Dell Technologies, said, “The Dell 14S has been designed to meet the expectations of young consumers who seek a balance of personal style, performance, battery life and affordability. We aim to bring premium laptop features to a wider segment of Indian consumers.” The Dell 14S is priced starting at ₹79,990 (inclusive of taxes) and is available through Dellstore.com. Introductory offers include zero-interest financing, credit card discounts of up to ₹10,000 and one-year Accidental Damage Protection at ₹499.

## Dell Inspiron 14 Plus

The new Inspiron 14 Plus is a clamshell-style laptop that comes with a Snapdragon X Plus chip, 16GB of memory, and 512GB of internal storage. It has a 14-inch touchscreen display with a 16:10 aspect ratio that's rated at 400 nits of brightness, and it also includes WiFi 7 support. When it comes to battery life, Dell says you can expect to get up to 21 hours of operation on a single charge. 

The Inspiron 14 Plus maintains a trim form factor at 0.67 inches thick but doesn't sacrifice on ports, offering one USB Type-A port, a headphone jack, two USB Type-C ports, and one microSD card slot.

The Inspiron 14 Plus is priced at $1,099.99. Dell's online storefront listed its soonest delivery date as June 19, while Best Buy had its release date set for June 28.
